client: Hi Luna, I've been feeling really overwhelmed lately. Balancing my full-time job at the marketing firm with taking care of my two young kids while my partner is away has been exhausting. Honestly, I'm not sure if therapy can help me with this; it just feels like a lot to handle all at once.
therapist:
Hi there! It sounds like you're carrying a lot on your shoulders right now, and it's completely understandable to feel overwhelmed with everything you have going on. Balancing a full-time job while caring for young kids can be incredibly demanding, especially when your partner isn’t around to share the load.

I hear you expressing some doubt about whether therapy can help with this situation. It’s okay to feel uncertain, and it's also a lot to process. I wonder, with everything you’re managing, if there’s a part of you that feels even more stressed or anxious than what you’re able to share. What do you think might be at the core of that feeling of being overwhelmed?
vocal_descriptors: very high pitch, moderate volume, very rapid speech
